data.key: Oath against Grotesquery ~ Code of Conduct
data.name: Code of Conduct
data.description: Respect the innate beauty in all things, and strive to preserve it from corruption and perversion. Never willfully cause damage to crafted objects or works of art, nor cause a creature or object to be deformed in any way.
